items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is one line, `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`, and it matches the surrounding style. No comment explains why the cache is kept, but the existing 'manage the reverse relation manually' comment gives enough context.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Uses the existing is_cached API, adds no new bookkeeping, and leaves no debug code (scratch/ was removed). The same guard appears in three get_prefetch_queryset methods, but each is a one-line application of one pattern, not copy-pasted logic.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guard is conditional, so plain prefetches still set the parent. It adds no exception handling or magic constants. The prefetch_related, defer and select_related suites pass, as do the hidden tests (85/85 P2P).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(...)`. The one-to-one path is guarded the same way in ReverseOneToOneDescriptor (`if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`), and the agent's test covers both paths.
